units.source_text: 古歌：“不忘欲忘终难忘，如之奈何如之何？”

en.t: An old poem says: "Even when I try not to forget, even when I try to forget, I still cannot forget; what am I to do?"
It appears in The Collected Works of Lord Seishin.

units.source_text: 左兵卫督之诗据此古歌。

en.t: The poem by the Captain of the Left Gate Guards is based on this old poem.
